text:
incidents-bot: PAGER: decode-pool-3 experiencing repeated GPU OOMs and container restarts (>5x in 3m). Severity P1. Paging on-call.

alice_oncall: ack, joining. Noted multiple restarts and elevated GPU memory. Hypothesis: runaway streaming generation / missing token cap.

alice_oncall: quick check: node GPU mem ~99%, pods restarting with CUDA OOMs in logs. CPU/IO look normal.

alice_oncall: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:12:42Z decode-worker-7 stderr: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.25 GiB (GPU 0; 15.90 GiB total capacity; 14.80 GiB already allocated; 512.00 MiB free; 2.00 GiB reserved)
  File "pluggable_decoder.py", line 482, in forward
  ...
```

ben_eng-runtime: digging in telemetry — KV cache size on decode-pool-3 spiked. Some streams showing sequence lengths >100k tokens. This suggests clients got to send unbounded max_tokens.

carla_sre: can you pull the request traces / headers?

ben_eng-runtime: pulling traces from edge logs. Found a cluster of requests from api-proxy-15 carrying `x-max-tokens: 0` (zero interpreted as no limit) right after the deploy. Looks like nginx passthrough change reverted default-clamp behavior.

alice_oncall: timeline: 01:40 small edge deploy to allow header passthrough for debugging -> 02:10 first OOMs -> 02:12 pager. @eva_product was that deploy intentional?

eva_product: yes, we toggled a route flag to forward client headers to reproduce a customer bug. I did not expect it to allow unbounded token values — will revert if it caused this.

dan_support: customer ACME (acme-112) opened a ticket at ~02:05 about partial streams and 502s, reporting ~7% error rate across their streaming workload.

frank_customer: ACME: we saw truncations and a handful of full failures; had to pause heavy batch jobs.

alice_oncall: immediate mitigations we should attempt: 1) inject a soft default max_tokens at the gateway; 2) clamp errant headers to a safe ceiling; 3) throttle streaming concurrency for decode-pool-3; 4) scale decode-pool temporarily.

ben_eng-runtime: I can push a router hotfix to clamp any `x-max-tokens` > 4096 down to 4096 and treat 0 as 1024 by default. Will also add defensive logic in runtime to enforce an absolute max.

alice_oncall: Apply hotfix to edge:
```
curl -X POST https://edge.internal/config/hotfix -H "Authorization: Bearer $HOTFIX_TOKEN" -d '{"default_max_tokens":1024, "max_tokens_ceiling":4096, "clamp_zero_to_default":true}'
```

carla_sre: scaling decode pool: `kubectl scale deployment/decode-pool-3 --replicas=6 --namespace=redwood-prod` -> in progress. Also preparing to cordon and drain flapping node decode-worker-7.

ben_eng-runtime: rolling runtime patch to canary (1/6) with header clamp and decoder defensive guard. Monitoring memory on canary.

ops-bot: Deploy initiated by ben_eng-runtime at 02:28 (deploy id dpl-20260315-7843). Canary healthy.

carla_sre: draining decode-worker-7 now: `kubectl cordon decode-worker-7 && kubectl drain decode-worker-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` -> completed, pods rescheduled across other nodes.

alice_oncall: any evictions or OOMs after hotfix on canary?

ben_eng-runtime: canary stable, no OOMs. After edge hotfix and runtime patch we see KV cache sizes dropping. CUDA OOMs stop after 02:34.

alice_oncall: customer impact update: ACME failure rate dropped from ~7% to ~1.2% after the edge hotfix. ACME confirmed reduced partials.

frank_customer: ACME: confirming improvements, thanks. We'll gradually unpause workloads and watch.

ben_eng-runtime: graphs show steady decline in aggregated attention state and KV memory. Likely root cause: header passthrough allowed unbounded/zero max_tokens to reach runtime, clients issued long-running streams, KV cache grew until GPU OOM. Also our alerting thresholds didn't give a pre-oom warning.

alice_oncall: mitigated at 02:36. Handing monitoring to night oncall @sam_oncall in 20m. Incident remains open for RCA items.

sam_oncall: ack, will monitor for next hour and escalate if anything reappears.

eva_product: preparing customer communication + status page update. ETA 02:50.

dan_support: updating ACME ticket and scheduling postmortem session.

alice_oncall: action items recorded:
- ben_eng-runtime: merge runtime defensive clamps + unit tests (PR #5291). Due 2026-03-16.
- carla_sre: add pre-oom streaming memory alert at 75% GPU mem and create automated throttling playbook. Due 2026-03-17.
- infra: implement silent default max_tokens=2048 at edge when header absent and disallow passthrough without feature flag. Ticket INF-874. Due 2026-03-18.
- product/support: customer comms + postmortem invite. Due 2026-03-16.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: decode-pool-3. Duration 00:24. Severity: mitigated. RCA required.

alice_oncall: closing active pager. Leaving thread open for RCA notes. Thanks for quick coordination. :thumbsup:

-- end of thread --
